name: asdair-cockpit-api
description: BUILD-015 AsdAIr Stage 1 - the READ side behind the cockpit's Apps > Asdair > Details workspace. SELECT-only assembly of the durable shop state (reusing shop/shopStatus.js), server-side presentation so 'unknown' and 'derived price' are enforced in tested code, and a thin dispatcher onto the SHARED channel-neutral command surface in services/asdair/pipeline/commands.js. Implements no shopping logic, never writes, never drives a browser, never checks out and never pays.
